summary: Iteration 8 testing complete: 25/25 backend tests PASS (auth guards on scan-invites, invite-log, invoice-checkout, payments status, Stripe webhook; idempotency of scan-invites; reviews public-only-approved; regression on contact/chat/admin login; super-admin JWT mint round-trip). Frontend testing verified: admin-zoho-login button on /admin/login, /admin/reviews cms-invite-panel + cms-invite-scan-now renders and triggers backend scan, /review page renders with project prefill from ?project=Website+Multibay, review form submits and success state appears, review-share-panel correctly HIDDEN when REACT_APP_* env vars are blank, /portal anon view renders zoho-login + register-form and does NOT show Betaal-nu button. Seed review 'TEST Iter8' cleaned up.

minor.issue: Bogus body (missing origin_url) returns 422 (Pydantic) BEFORE portal auth check. Review spec expected 401 first. Contract still safe (unauthorized cannot proceed) but ordering differs from spec. Recommend using request-level Depends for auth so 401 fires before body validation.

action_items: OPTIONAL: reorder Stripe /payments/invoice-checkout to check portal session before Pydantic body validation so bogus payloads return 401 (matches Iteration 8 spec).
No blocking issues — feature set is production-safe.
critical_code_review_comments: stripe_payments.py checkout endpoint validates body before auth — attacker can enumerate schema without valid session. Low-risk but violates fail-closed principle.
server.py is ~805 lines — consider extracting review CRUD into a submodule as file continues to grow.
review_invites and stripe_payments routers correctly guarded; MongoDB _id fields excluded via projections.

JWT secret loaded from env with 'change-me' fallback in both server.py and zoho_portal.py — good, but the fallback would silently mismatch tokens in the two modules if env is ever missing. Consider raising RuntimeError instead.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows (Zoho-authenticated Portal Betaal-nu path skipped per spec)

test_credentials: admin@pearblue.nl / PearBlue2026! (JWT). Super-admin Zoho: beheer@multibay.eu (tokens stored in db.zoho_users, not modified).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 review 'TEST Iter8' via UI + a few via pytest, all cleaned up after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend .env exports REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from within test module (via dotenv_values) — good. For super-admin mint token test to work in-process, we now push _env into os.environ.setdefault so zoho_portal picks up JWT_SECRET. Reviews approved=false query param has been removed as expected — public list is always approved-only. Feature B end-to-end (Stripe -> Zoho Books mark-paid) can only be validated with a real Stripe test checkout completion; only auth guards + status/webhook contracts were tested here.
